newsitem.title: USA: Ensco to buy remaining interest in rig.
newsitem.headline: Ensco to buy remaining interest in rig.

text.p: Ensco International Inc said on Wednesday it agreed in principle to buy the 51 percent it does not already own of a premium jackup rig in Southeast Asia for an undisclosed sum.
Ensco acquired a 49 percent interest in the rig in June 1996 when it acquired Dual Drilling Co. It expects to close the rig purchase in May 1997.
The rig, a Friede & Goldman L780 Mod II design, will be renamed the Ensco 57.
Ensco also said its average day rate for its 35 jackup rigs was about $41,000 for the first quarter of 1997, up from $28,000 for the same period a year ago.

Utilization edged down to 88 percent from 91 percent due to downtime on six jackup rigs, three of which have now returned to service. The remaining three are expected back in service later this month or in May.
